basis.boundary: Manual-derived hierarchy is a source baseline, not an as-installed certificate. Ownership is provisional and uncertain tags are omitted pending plant verification.

assetClasses.name: Base
assetClasses.shortDescription: Insulated charge-support base and protective-atmosphere interface.
assetClasses.longDescription: Supports the charge and Inner Cover, circulates protective atmosphere, provides sealing, temperature measurement, water cooling and hydraulic clamping interfaces.

hierarchy.name: Structure, sealing and charge support
hierarchy.shortDescription: Load-bearing, insulated, sealing and charge-support elements.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM pp.17-24; MM pp.4-5

children.name: Base frame
children.shortDescription: Structural steel frame supporting charge, Inner Cover and operating assemblies.

children.name: Insulated sheath
children.shortDescription: Stainless covering over the base insulation.

children.name: Base seal (O-ring)
children.shortDescription: Forms the protective-atmosphere seal with the Inner Cover mating surface.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM p.4

children.name: Oil trough
children.shortDescription: Collects volatilized oil, water and debris at the base.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM p.4

children.name: Inner Cover guide pins
children.shortDescription: Guide the Inner Cover into its final position on the Base.

children.name: Diffuser
children.shortDescription: Directs protective-atmosphere flow through the charge stack.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM pp.4-5

children.name: Charge plate
children.shortDescription: Supports the charge and forms part of the atmosphere-flow path.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM p.5

children.name: Convector plate
children.shortDescription: Separates coils and permits protective-atmosphere circulation between them.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM p.5

hierarchy.name: Base fan and convection system
hierarchy.shortDescription: Recirculates protective atmosphere through the charge.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM pp.4-6

children.name: Base fan assembly
children.shortDescription: Motor, impeller and mounting elements for atmosphere circulation.

children.name: Base fan motor
children.shortDescription: Drives the base fan wheel, normally under variable-frequency control.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM base-fan service procedures

children.name: Fan wheel
children.shortDescription: Impeller that circulates protective atmosphere through the charge.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM pp.4-5

children.name: Motor mounting and shaft hardware
children.shortDescription: Mounting studs, lock washers, shaft key and service adapter used by the fan assembly.

children.name: Base fan motor high-temperature switch
children.shortDescription: Signals excessive base fan-motor temperature.
children.sourceReference: SOM device list; installed parent to verify

children.name: Base fan motor purge low-flow switch
children.shortDescription: Proves minimum purge airflow for the base fan motor.
children.sourceReference: SOM device list; installed parent to verify

children.name: Base fan motor vibration transmitter
children.shortDescription: Transmits fan-motor vibration for alarm and condition monitoring.

hierarchy.name: Hydraulic clamping system
hierarchy.shortDescription: Clamps the Inner Cover against the Base seal and proves clamping pressure.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM pp.4,7

children.name: Hydraulic clamps
children.shortDescription: Hold the Inner Cover against the Base O-ring seal.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM pp.4,7

children.name: Hydraulic pressure gauge
children.shortDescription: Indicates actual hydraulic clamping pressure.

children.name: Clamp low-pressure switch A
children.shortDescription: Proves hydraulic clamping pressure for one clamp circuit.

children.name: Clamp low-pressure switch B
children.shortDescription: Proves hydraulic clamping pressure for the second clamp circuit.

children.name: Clamp solenoid valve A
children.shortDescription: Actuates one half of the hydraulic clamps.

children.name: Clamp solenoid valve B
children.shortDescription: Actuates the other half of the hydraulic clamps.

children.name: Hydraulic manual valves
children.shortDescription: Provide local isolation or operation of the clamp circuits.

hierarchy.name: Protective-atmosphere piping and pressure control
hierarchy.shortDescription: Contains, measures and controls the protective atmosphere under the Inner Cover.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM pp.53,205; MM pp.4-6

children.name: Base atmosphere piping
children.shortDescription: Piping and valves serving the protective-atmosphere circuit at the Base.

children.name: Inner Cover pressure transmitter
children.shortDescription: Transmits pressure under the Inner Cover to the control system.

children.name: Back-pressure valve
children.shortDescription: Maintains positive pressure under the Inner Cover.

children.name: Atmosphere oil-drain control valve
children.shortDescription: Controls oil drainage from the atmosphere circuit.

children.name: Atmosphere exhaust control valve
children.shortDescription: Diverts atmosphere exhaust to the waste-gas system.

hierarchy.name: Water cooling and drainage
hierarchy.shortDescription: Base and Inner Cover cooling-water interfaces, measurement and collection.

children.name: Water box
children.shortDescription: Collects water returning from the Base and Forced Cooler interfaces.

children.name: Base water jackets
children.shortDescription: Carry cooling water through the Base cooling surfaces.

children.name: Water connections
children.shortDescription: Connect Base and Inner Cover cooling-water circuits.

children.name: Base cooling-water flow switch and indicator
children.shortDescription: Indicates water flow and initiates the documented low-flow protective response.

children.name: Cooling-water exit temperature element
children.shortDescription: Reports water temperature leaving the Inner Cover water jacket.

hierarchy.name: Charge and Base temperature measurement
hierarchy.shortDescription: Measures gas-stream and Base temperatures used by process control and maintenance.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM p.5

children.name: Gas-stream thermocouple A
children.shortDescription: Transmits one protective-atmosphere gas-stream temperature.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM p.5

children.name: Gas-stream thermocouple B
children.shortDescription: Transmits the second protective-atmosphere gas-stream temperature.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM p.5

children.name: Base thermocouple
children.shortDescription: Transmits Base temperature to the control system.
children.sourceReference: SOM Base / Insulated Frame; MM p.5

assetClasses.name: Furnace
assetClasses.shortDescription: Movable recuperated mixed-fuel direct-fired heating furnace.
assetClasses.longDescription: Provides controlled heating around an Inner Cover through combustion-air, mixed-fuel, burner, recuperation, exhaust, refractory, electrical-control and safety systems.

hierarchy.name: Structure, movement and sealing
hierarchy.shortDescription: Movable furnace shell, guidance, lifting and Base sealing interface.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Furnace Assembly; MM pp.10-11

children.name: Furnace casing
children.shortDescription: Mild-steel shell carrying insulation and furnace-mounted systems.

children.name: Lifting eye
children.shortDescription: Provides the approved crane lifting point for furnace movement.

children.name: Guide arms
children.shortDescription: Engage Base guide posts to position the Furnace.

children.name: Draft-seal assembly
children.shortDescription: Limits waste-gas leakage at the Furnace-to-Base interface.
children.sourceReference: SOM Typical Draft Seal Assembly; MM pp.10-11

children.name: Draft seal
children.shortDescription: Flexible sealing element around the lower furnace opening.

children.name: Draft-seal support and clamping hardware
children.shortDescription: Supports and retains the draft-seal element.

hierarchy.name: Refractory and heat containment
hierarchy.shortDescription: Insulation and refractory elements retaining process heat and protecting the shell.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Furnace and Recuperator assemblies; MM furnace sections

children.name: Furnace insulation and refractory lining
children.shortDescription: Thermally insulates the steel casing from the furnace chamber.

children.name: Burner blocks and firing tubes
children.shortDescription: Refractory burner interfaces whose condition affects flame shape and hot-spot risk.

hierarchy.name: Combustion-air system
hierarchy.shortDescription: Supplies, measures, heats and distributes combustion air to the burners.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Air Piping and Recuperator assemblies; MM pp.10,12-13

children.name: Combustion-air blower assembly
children.shortDescription: Supplies combustion air to the furnace air manifold.
children.sourceReference: SOM Air Piping Assembly; MM pp.10,12-13

children.name: Combustion-air piping and manifold
children.shortDescription: Distributes combustion air from the blower and recuperator to each burner.

children.name: Recuperator
children.shortDescription: Recovers heat from furnace waste gas to preheat combustion air.

children.name: Combustion-air flow control valve
children.shortDescription: Modulates combustion-air flow to the Furnace.

children.name: Combustion-air valve position feedback
children.shortDescription: Reports the combustion-air control-valve position.

children.name: Combustion-air flow and pressure proving
children.shortDescription: Provides flow and pressure permissives for safe burner operation.
children.sourceReference: SOM Air Piping Assembly; MM pp.12-13

hierarchy.name: Mixed-fuel gas train
hierarchy.shortDescription: Admits, measures, regulates, isolates and distributes mixed fuel to the burners.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Mixed Fuel Piping Assembly; MM pp.10-13

children.name: Mixed-fuel piping and header
children.shortDescription: Distributes mixed fuel from the Furnace inlet to individual burners.
children.sourceReference: SOM Mixed Fuel Piping Assembly; MM pp.10-11

children.name: Mixed-fuel flexible hose and quick connect
children.shortDescription: Connects the movable Furnace to the fixed fuel supply.
children.sourceReference: SOM Mixed Fuel Piping Assembly; MM p.10

children.name: Furnace fuel safety shutoff valve
children.shortDescription: Admits or isolates mixed fuel under combustion-safety control.

children.name: Furnace fuel-valve solenoid operator
children.shortDescription: Operates the Furnace fuel safety shutoff valve.

children.name: Fuel flow control valve
children.shortDescription: Modulates mixed-fuel flow to the Furnace.

children.name: Fuel control-valve position feedback
children.shortDescription: Reports fuel control-valve position feedback channels.

children.name: Fuel pressure measurement and switches
children.shortDescription: Measures fuel pressure and proves high/low safety limits.
children.sourceReference: SOM Mixed Fuel Piping Assembly; MM furnace troubleshooting

hierarchy.name: Eight-burner firing system
hierarchy.shortDescription: Eight burner positions with ignition, flame detection and local fuel isolation.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Typical Burner Assembly; MM pp.10-13

children.name: Typical burner assembly (positions 1-8)
children.shortDescription: Reusable component definition for each of the eight numbered burner positions.
children.applicability: Eight installed positions per Furnace; retain burner number in work and installed-component records.

children.name: Burner body, air inlet and fuel inlet
children.shortDescription: Mixes and directs combustion air and fuel into the firing zone.

children.name: Spark ignitor, rod and holder
children.shortDescription: Produces and positions the ignition spark for burner light-off.
children.sourceReference: SOM Typical Burner Assembly; MM p.10

children.name: Burner ignition transformer
children.shortDescription: Supplies high voltage to the spark ignitor.

children.name: UV flame scanner and peep sight
children.shortDescription: Detects burner flame and provides an inspection path.
children.sourceReference: SOM Typical Burner Assembly; MM pp.10,13

children.name: Burner fuel safety shutoff valve
children.shortDescription: Admits or isolates fuel at one burner under flame-safety control.
children.sourceReference: SOM tagged-device list; exact position tags to verify

children.name: Burner guard
children.shortDescription: Protects exposed burner hardware from accidental contact or damage.

hierarchy.name: Waste-gas collection and downcomer
hierarchy.shortDescription: Collects Furnace exhaust and directs it to the waste-gas flue tunnel.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Furnace Downcomer Assembly

children.name: Furnace waste-gas collection hood
children.shortDescription: Collects combustion products leaving the Furnace.

children.name: Downcomer
children.shortDescription: Directs collected waste gas to the foundation flue tunnel.

children.name: Waste-gas damper
children.shortDescription: Controls the Furnace exhaust path into the waste-gas flue.

hierarchy.name: Furnace temperature measurement
hierarchy.shortDescription: Measures Furnace temperature for control and high-limit protection.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Furnace Assembly; MM p.10

children.name: Furnace thermocouple A
children.shortDescription: Provides one Furnace temperature measurement channel.

children.name: Furnace thermocouple B
children.shortDescription: Provides the second Furnace temperature measurement channel.

hierarchy.name: Electrical control and flame safety
hierarchy.shortDescription: Distributes power and executes purge, permissive, ignition and flame-safety logic.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Furnace Assembly; MM pp.10-13

children.name: Furnace power panel
children.shortDescription: Distributes high- and low-voltage power to Furnace systems.

children.name: Furnace control and flame-safety panel
children.shortDescription: Contains flame-safety, purge and high-limit control equipment.

children.name: Power, control and analog plugs
children.shortDescription: Connect movable Furnace power, control and thermocouple circuits to the Base services.

assetClasses.name: Forced Cooler
assetClasses.shortDescription: Movable air-and-water cooling package for post-heating charge cooling.
assetClasses.longDescription: Fits over an Inner Cover and provides forced-air and spray-water cooling through structural, blower, water-manifold and electrical-control assemblies.

hierarchy.name: Structure, movement and positioning
hierarchy.shortDescription: Movable casing and hardware used to lift, guide and position the Forced Cooler.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Forced Cooler Assembly; MM p.14

children.name: Forced-cooling casing
children.shortDescription: Stainless shell that sits over the Inner Cover during cooling.

children.name: Lifting eye
children.shortDescription: Provides the approved crane lifting point for Forced Cooler movement.
children.sourceReference: SOM Forced Cooler Assembly; MM p.14

children.name: Guide arms
children.shortDescription: Engage Base guide posts to position the Forced Cooler.

children.name: Striker arms
children.shortDescription: Engage the Inner Cover drain spout to support cooling-water drainage.
children.sourceReference: SOM Forced Cooler Assembly; MM p.14

hierarchy.name: Forced-air cooling system
hierarchy.shortDescription: Two blower trains circulate cooling air around the Inner Cover.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Forced Cooler Assembly; MM pp.14-15

children.name: Cooler blower assemblies
children.shortDescription: Two motor-driven blowers provide forced cooling air.
children.applicability: Two blower assemblies per Forced Cooler.
children.sourceReference: SOM Forced Cooler Assembly; MM pp.14-15

children.name: Blower transition ducts
children.shortDescription: Direct blower discharge into the cooling casing.

hierarchy.name: Spray-water system
hierarchy.shortDescription: Connects, distributes, sprays, indicates and drains cooling water.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Forced Cooler and Water Piping assemblies; MM pp.14-15

children.name: Forced Cooler water piping
children.shortDescription: Directs plant water to the two spray manifolds.
children.sourceReference: SOM Water Piping Assembly; MM p.14

children.name: Flexible water hose and quick connect
children.shortDescription: Connects the movable cooler to the Base-area water supply.
children.sourceReference: SOM Water Piping Assembly; MM p.14

children.name: Spray-water manual shutoff valve
children.shortDescription: Provides local manual isolation of spray-water flow.
children.sourceReference: SOM Water Piping Assembly; MM p.14

children.name: Water manifolds
children.shortDescription: Two manifolds distribute cooling water around the Inner Cover.

children.name: Spray nozzles
children.shortDescription: Apply cooling water evenly to the Inner Cover exterior.
children.sourceReference: SOM Water Piping Assembly; MM p.14

children.name: Water-manifold clean-out
children.shortDescription: Provides access for cleaning the spray-water manifold.

children.name: Forced Cooler water flow indicator/switch
children.shortDescription: Indicates or proves cooling-water flow; exact installed tag must be verified before tag assignment.
children.sourceReference: SOM/MM references conflict between FISL60 and Base FISL61; tag intentionally unassigned

hierarchy.name: Electrical supply and control
hierarchy.shortDescription: Powers and controls the blower and cooling-water interfaces.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Forced Cooler Assembly; MM p.14

children.name: Forced Cooler control panel
children.shortDescription: Contains local electrical control equipment for cooler operation.

children.name: Power and control plugs
children.shortDescription: Connect the movable cooler to Base-area power and control services.
children.sourceReference: SOM Forced Cooler Assembly; MM p.14

assetClasses.name: Inner Cover
assetClasses.shortDescription: Serial-controlled protective-atmosphere enclosure used on a Base.
assetClasses.longDescription: Movable stainless enclosure forming the protective chamber around the charge, with fabrication genealogy, sealing, guidance, lifting, water-cooling and drainage elements.

hierarchy.name: Fabricated enclosure and genealogy sections
hierarchy.shortDescription: Serial-controlled enclosure sections captured during purchase or fabrication registration.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Inner Cover; governed fabrication model aligned to plant instruction

children.name: Lower assembly
children.shortDescription: Lower fabricated section supporting the shell and sealing interface.

children.name: Flat vertical section
children.shortDescription: Flat stainless vertical section recorded as new or donor-derived material.

children.name: Corrugated shell
children.shortDescription: Corrugated shell section assembled from recorded new or donor cut lengths.

children.name: Top cover / head
children.shortDescription: Dished top section closing the protective-atmosphere enclosure.
children.sourceReference: SOM Inner Cover; governed fabrication section: topCover

hierarchy.name: Lifting, guidance and positioning
hierarchy.shortDescription: Features used to lift and locate the Inner Cover on a Base.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Inner Cover; MM p.8

children.name: Lifting ring and lugs
children.shortDescription: Provides the approved crane lifting interface for Inner Cover movement.

children.name: Guide arms
children.shortDescription: Engage Base guide posts during positioning.

children.name: Guide-pin guides
children.shortDescription: Receive Base guide pins and guide final placement.

hierarchy.name: Water cooling and drainage
hierarchy.shortDescription: Receives Forced Cooler spray water, cools the seal area and drains collected water.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Inner Cover; MM pp.8-9

children.name: Water catch ring
children.shortDescription: Collects water sprayed onto the Inner Cover by the Forced Cooler.

children.name: Cooling jacket
children.shortDescription: Carries cooling water to protect the lower seal region.

children.name: Water connections
children.shortDescription: Connect the Inner Cover cooling jacket to Base-area water hoses.

children.name: Drain-spout assembly
children.shortDescription: Drains collected cooling water when actuated by the Forced Cooler striker arm.

children.name: Drain spout
children.shortDescription: Directs collected water away from the Inner Cover.

children.name: Drain-spout spring
children.shortDescription: Returns or biases the drain mechanism.

children.name: Drain-spout plunger
children.shortDescription: Opens the drain path when mechanically actuated.

children.name: Plunger gasket
children.shortDescription: Seals the drain plunger when closed.

children.name: Fusible plug
children.shortDescription: Relieves pressure arising from excessive water-jacket temperature under the documented design condition.

hierarchy.name: Protective-atmosphere sealing interface
hierarchy.shortDescription: Mates with the Base O-ring to form the protective chamber around the charge.
hierarchy.sourceReference: SOM Inner Cover; MM pp.8-9

children.name: Seal mating surface
children.shortDescription: Machined lower surface that bears against the Base seal.
